verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official MCP server, and the probe confirms the get-started page exists. Through it, an AI tool can read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and draft messages via natural language. Reads are separated from writes and deletes so each category can be approved independently. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented connection/authentication setup steps and supported clients.
